IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
 CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION 
 CRIMINAL WRIT PETITION NO. 4574 OF 2024 
Pranita Vishnu Waghchoure 
Nee Pranita Prithviraj R. Rathod … Petitioner 
            
Versus
The State of Maharashtra & Ors. … Respondents
Mr. Umair Ansari i/b Mr. Mohsin Khan for the Petitioner 
Mr. V . B. Konde Deshmukh, Addl. P .P for the Respondent Nos.1 
to 5-State 
None for the Respondent Nos. 6 to 10  
                CORAM :  REVATI MOHITE DERE  & 
                                   PRITHVIRAJ K. CHAVAN,   JJ.  
             MONDAY, 11  th   NOVEMBER 2024   
P.C :
1 By this petition, the petitioner seeks a direction to the
respondent Nos. 2 to 5 to register an FIR as against respondent
Nos. 6 to 10 under the provisions of the Scheduled Castes and
Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act as well as under
the provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

2 Mr.  Konde  Deshmukh,  learned  Addl.  P .P ,  on
instructions, submits that the police have conducted a preliminary
inquiry  into  the  petitioner’s  complaint  and  have  come  to  the
conclusion  that  no  cognizable  offence  is  disclosed  and  have
accordingly,  
filed the petitioner’s complaint. He states that the
said decision has been communicated to the petitioner by post.
Mr. Konde Deshmukh further assures that a copy of the said
communication  will  be  served  to  the  learned  counsel  for  the
petitioner during the course of the day, since according to the
petitioner, he has not received any communication.  Statement
accepted. 
3 In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives for further
consideration in the petition.  Petition is accordingly disposed of. 
4 Needless to state that it is now open for the petitioner
to adopt appropriate remedy as permissible in law before the
  SQ Pathan                                                                                              2/3
